item.title: Nish Kumar Backs Rewilding as Calls Grow for 30% Nature Restoration Across Britain
item.description: This story matters because growing public support for rewilding is outpacing political action, and voices like Nish Kumar’s highlight the urgency of restoring nature at scale to protect wildlife, strengthen communities and rebuild Britain’s depleted landscapes.The post Nish Kumar Backs Rewilding as Calls Grow for 30% Nature Restoration Across Britain appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Energy Secretary Sets Out Vision for “Golden Age of Nuclear” at Industry Conference
item.description: This story matters because the government is committing to the largest expansion of nuclear power in half a century, aiming to cut emissions, strengthen energy security and deliver thousands of skilled jobs across the UK as part of a long term clean energy strategy.The post Energy Secretary Sets Out Vision for “Golden Age of Nuclear” at Industry Conference appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Crofter Celebrated as Scotland’s Finest Woods Awards Honour Outstanding Woodland Work
item.description: This story matters because it highlights the innovation and community effort driving Scotland’s woodland revival, from Highland crofts to urban planting, showing how forestry is reshaping landscapes, supporting livelihoods and helping the country respond to climate and biodiversity challenges.The post Highland Crofter Celebrated as Scotland’s Finest Woods Awards Honour Outstanding Woodland Work appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Planning Consent Granted for Final Phase of Inverness Campus Development
item.description: Planning approval for the next stage of Inverness Campus sets the scene for new industries, academic expansion and job creation, signalling a fresh chapter for one of the Highlands’ most significant centres of development and long term opportunity.The post Planning Consent Granted for Final Phase of Inverness Campus Development appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Direct UK–Germany Rail Link Moves Closer With New Eurostar and Deutsche Bahn Partnership
item.description: A new Eurostar and Deutsche Bahn partnership brings direct UK Germany rail travel a step closer, promising faster journeys, greener connections and stronger economic links as both countries work toward launching the first high speed services between London and major German cities in the early 2030s.The post Direct UK–Germany Rail Link Moves Closer With New Eurostar and Deutsche Bahn Partnership appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Starmer Accused of Being Clueless on Labour’s Tax on Scotland’s Energy
item.description: Scotland’s offshore industry is warning of deepening job losses and declining revenues under the current Energy Profits Levy, prompting calls for urgent action as the country weighs the future of its energy workforce and the long term health of its wider economy.The post Starmer Accused of Being Clueless on Labour’s Tax on Scotland’s Energy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Red Squirrel Range in Highlands Increases by Over 25% Following Major Reintroduction Project by Rewilding Charity
item.description: Red squirrels are returning to the Highlands in numbers as a decade long rewilding effort boosts their range by more than a quarter, offering fresh hope for an iconic species and highlighting how targeted restoration can reshape Scotland’s woodland future.The post Red Squirrel Range in Highlands Increases by Over 25% Following Major Reintroduction Project by Rewilding Charity appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Big Rab Mulheron Steps into The Spotlight as Inverness Town House Prepares for a Night of Highland Laughter
item.description: Big Rab Mulheron returns to Inverness Town House as one of the Highlands most loved comics, bringing decades of storytelling, fearless humour and a genuine connection with audiences to a Christmas show that celebrates the talent reshaping the region’s growing comedy scene.The post Big Rab Mulheron Steps into The Spotlight as Inverness Town House Prepares for a Night of Highland Laughter appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.description: Snow White at Eden Court delivers a warm and joyful Highland panto full of laughter, music and festive magic, offering families a night of real connection as a talented cast brings heart, humour and creativity to one of the season’s must see shows.The post Snow White Shines at Eden Court With a Magical Highland Panto Full of Heart and Laughter appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Man Charged Following Death of Iain Gordon Macfarlane in Inverness
item.description: Iain Gordon Macfarlane, 32, from the Ullapool area, has been named locally after his death in Strathspey Place in Inverness, with police confirming a 52 year old man has been charged and that the incident was contained to the property.The post Man Charged Following Death of Iain Gordon Macfarlane in Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.
